race.comment: HADES DANGER (1) finished in the minors last time but the start prior broke the clock when winning over 340m at this track, taking a Grade 4 in a handy 19.44. Can return to winning form here if runs up to time two back. ALVESTON (5) goes very well here starting 20 times for eight wins and seven minors. Was out of placings last time (26.15) at this track in a Special conditions race, finishing fifth and beaten 3.5 lengths. With even luck and a clean start should be thereabouts. CRACKERJACK OAK (7) turned in a good run last time, finishing in the placings (19.71) at this track in a Restricted WIN. Lines up from box 7 for the first time. All two career wins have been at this trip. Expected to be in the finish again. ROSIES RETURN (3) has top-three aspirations after placing here over this journey last time.
